note: field naming inconsistencies preserved from upstream ETL

steps.title: Drain & remove breather plug
steps.instruction: Place unit on bench, output flange facing operator. Unscrew the breather/filler plug from the top of the housing (17 mm). Allow residual oil to drip for approx. 10 min. Check the sight glass for metal swarf.  NOTE: sight glass is not fitted on -E variants.

steps.title: Remove front cover flange bolts
steps.instruction: Remove the six M6 hex head bolts on the front cover flange (outer bolt circle) in a criss-cross pattern. Torque on refit: 9.5 Nm (84 lb-in). Do NOT confuse these with the mid-ring bolts -- flange bolts sit on the raised boss.

steps.title: Extract locating dowel pins
steps.instruction: Using a pin puller, withdraw all six locating dowel pins from the front cover mating face. Tag each pin with its bore position; pins are matched to their bores from factory honing.

steps.title: Remove drive-end front bearing cap
steps.instruction: On the drive end (A-side, nearest the input pinion), remove the FRONT bearing retainer cap. Ref. GBX-BC-108. See Fig. 4-2.

steps.title: Remove drive-end rear bearing cap
steps.instruction: Rotate the unit and remove the REAR bearing retainer cap on the same (drive) end. Keep shim pack together -- shim thickness sets pinion mesh preload.

steps.title: Free the A-side mid-ring bolts
steps.instruction: Slacken and remove both mid-ring retaining bolts on the drive end (mid bolt circle, z-mid row). CAUTION: bolts are grade 8.8 -- do not substitute.

steps.title: Replace drive-end front oil seal
steps.instruction: Pry out the radial oil seal (Simmering type) from the drive-end front bore. Fit new seal GBX-OS-124-B flush to 0.5 mm below face; lip grease: Klueber GL-261. Old 0-ring must be discarded.

steps.title: Withdraw input shaft & pinions
steps.instruction: Support the input shaft and withdraw it together with both input pinions toward the drive end. Do not let the pinion teeth strike the case web.

steps.title: Remove input circlips & thrust washers
steps.instruction: Remove the internal circlips (DIN 472) and both bronze thrust washers from the upper bores. Circlip pliers A-2 required.

steps.title: Remove rear ring bolts
steps.instruction: Remove the six hex bolts of the rear bolt ring (rear cover row, opposite the front flange). Refit torque 9,5 Nm. One bolt is fitted with a bonded washer -- note its position.

steps.title: Remove socket cap screws
steps.instruction: Remove all six DIN 912 socket head cap screws (5 mm hex) from the case split line. Refit torque: 13 Nm / 115 lb-in / 132 kpcm.

steps.title: Split housing halves
steps.instruction: Using jacking screws in the cast bosses, separate the two housing halves evenly. NEVER insert a screwdriver in the split line. Lift the upper half clear of both layshafts.

steps.title: Lift out layshaft assemblies
steps.instruction: Lift both layshaft (countershaft) assemblies out of the lower half. Keep A-side and B-side shafts separate; they are NOT interchangeable after run-in.

steps.title: Strip cluster & helical gears
steps.instruction: Press the cluster gear blocks and all helical reduction gears off their shafts. Inspect tooth flanks for pitting (max. allowable: DIN 3979 class 2). Mark gear-to-shaft clocking.

steps.title: Replace needle bearings
steps.instruction: Drive out all six needle roller bearing cages from the case webs using drift T-4408 and press in new cages to a depth of 2.5 mm. Lube with assembly paste before fitting.

steps.title: Renew snap rings, shims & sleeves
steps.instruction: Renew both external snap rings and the adjusting shim, and check both distance sleeves for scoring (replace if > 0.05 mm). Shim pack sets end-float 0.10-0.25 mm.

steps.title: Remove coupling flange & key
steps.instruction: Lock the output shaft and remove the coupling flange from its taper. Extract the parallel shaft keys (DIN 6885) from both keyways -- use key puller, do not lever against the seal face.

steps.title: Withdraw output shaft & spur gear
steps.instruction: Withdraw the output shaft together with both output spur gears toward the B-side. Support the gear rim; combined mass approx. 6,2 kg.

steps.title: Replace B-side bearings & seals
steps.instruction: On the output end, extract both cylindrical roller bearings and both radial oil seals, then refit the output-end bearing caps (front and rear) with new gaskets. Heat bearings to 80 degC max. for fitting; never use open flame.
